implementation_boundary: No ACCORD-03 code is changed or used as normative evidence.

OPTION_A_EXPLICIT_STAGE_PER_VECTOR.predicate_resolution: Exact tuple resolution can be reused after vector targets receive explicit stages and URN-to-profile identity is declared.
OPTION_A_EXPLICIT_STAGE_PER_VECTOR.binding: Proposition descriptor and evidence coverage must carry the same exact stage.
OPTION_A_EXPLICIT_STAGE_PER_VECTOR.settlement: Partial/evidence outcomes become evaluable against a declared requested stage.
OPTION_A_EXPLICIT_STAGE_PER_VECTOR.projection: R1 mapping can use existing stage-bearing projection requirements.
OPTION_A_EXPLICIT_STAGE_PER_VECTOR.vector_execution: All 23 vectors require fixture amendment and re-certification.
OPTION_A_EXPLICIT_STAGE_PER_VECTOR.certification: E2 vector certification can target 23 exact tuples after amendment.

OPTION_B_GENERIC_EXTERNAL_EFFECT_STAGELE.predicate_resolution: Would require a new stage-less resolution path, contrary to the current exact stage-bearing contract.
OPTION_B_GENERIC_EXTERNAL_EFFECT_STAGELE.binding: Would need a new generic proposition identity rule.
OPTION_B_GENERIC_EXTERNAL_EFFECT_STAGELE.settlement: Would need explicit provider-acceptance, occurrence, partial-effect, and later-stage rules.
OPTION_B_GENERIC_EXTERNAL_EFFECT_STAGELE.projection: Would need non-strengthening rules for stage-less output.
OPTION_B_GENERIC_EXTERNAL_EFFECT_STAGELE.vector_execution: Could not be adopted by implementation without a broader semantic change.

OPTION_C_GENERIC_PLUS_REQUESTED_MINIMUM_.predicate_resolution: Requires a new target minimum-stage field and a profile-bound ordering/comparison contract.
OPTION_C_GENERIC_PLUS_REQUESTED_MINIMUM_.binding: Evidence must bind the same generic predicate and satisfy the minimum-stage relation.
OPTION_C_GENERIC_PLUS_REQUESTED_MINIMUM_.settlement: Partial effect becomes a below-minimum-stage result.
OPTION_C_GENERIC_PLUS_REQUESTED_MINIMUM_.projection: Projection must preserve requested minimum stage and not strengthen it.
OPTION_C_GENERIC_PLUS_REQUESTED_MINIMUM_.vector_execution: All affected vectors require explicit minimum stage values.
OPTION_C_GENERIC_PLUS_REQUESTED_MINIMUM_.certification: Needs new package version and new test vectors.

OPTION_D_TYPED_HYBRID.predicate_resolution: Exact stage-specific registry for positive rows plus distinct typed contracts for generic external effect and complete-negative.
OPTION_D_TYPED_HYBRID.binding: Positive propositions retain exact stage; negative/query propositions bind scope, interval, completeness, retention, and freshness.
OPTION_D_TYPED_HYBRID.settlement: Preserves partial staged effects and bounded non-occurrence without forcing negative evidence into a positive stage row.
OPTION_D_TYPED_HYBRID.projection: Existing native-C projection can remain stage/proposition constrained.
OPTION_D_TYPED_HYBRID.vector_execution: Requires explicit decision for 18 external-effect vectors and V013.
OPTION_D_TYPED_HYBRID.certification: Requires fresh package/vector certification after normative amendment.
